feature: Actual installed Apple summary translation acceptance

scenarios.name: Translate a saved summary with the actual installed Chinese pair or explain missing setup
scenarios.given: the native Mac has an English summary with two factual paragraphs and a fenced code block, and actual Apple language-pack readiness
scenarios.when: the user explicitly requests Simplified Chinese summary translation
scenarios.then: an installed pair completes within the bounded request budget with Chinese prose, the budget number and Thursday meaning intact, code and original unchanged; a missing or unsupported pair instead shows explicit setup or unsupported guidance with no derived output and never initiates a download; the observed branch is retained
